integrity: The spectrum identity is proved directly from the quantifiers in relative computable categoricity and uses the cited paper only for the surrounding framework and definitions. Originality is best-of-knowledge after targeted literature and semantic-overlap checks. scientific_limitations: Finite tagged disjoint unions only. The unary component predicates are essential to the proof, no countable-union uniformity is claimed, and the result concerns relative rather than ordinary computable categoricity.
title: Tagged disjoint unions turn relative categoricity spectra into intersections
